This test fails: `page(items, 2)` should return items 10-19 but returns 11-20. What's wrong?

Looking at `page(items, page_num)`: the slice `items[page_num*10:(page_num+1)*10]` for page 2 gives `items[20:30]`, not `items[10:20]`. If page numbering is 1-based (page 1 = items 0-9), the fix is `items[(page_num-1)*10:page_num*10]`.
Good catch. Please write a regression test for this.

```python
def test_page_1_based():
    items = list(range(30))
    assert page(items, 1) == list(range(0, 10))
    assert page(items, 2) == list(range(10, 20))
    assert page(items, 3) == list(range(20, 30))
```
